title: Draft the entire first manuscript

stage.name: First draft
stage.description: The whole story is written down, rough edges and all.

intro: Done is better than perfect, for now.

questions.prompt: What is the goal of a first draft?
options: Getting the whole story down; imperfect is fine
questions.why: You can't fix a page you haven't written.

questions.prompt: Many writers avoid heavy editing while drafting so they can keep moving forward.
questions.why: Drafting and editing use different mindsets. Mixing them often stalls both.

items: Keep going through the hard chapters
Reach the end of the story
questions.why: A little distance helps you see the draft with fresh eyes.

questions.prompt: Living your story together will include messy chapters. What helps?
options: Accepting that mistakes happen and keeping going together
Giving up at the first hard chapter
Blaming one person for every problem
questions.why: Every good story has hard chapters. What matters is turning the page together.

talk: What's a hard chapter you're glad you came through?
